description: Foundation: two admin roles (Admin = front desk, Business Admin), staff accounts, sign-in, role-aware shell/menus/guards, shared helpers, seed data for every later page, wording sweep, and the verification harness. Must go first; FEAT-002..004 depend on it. Covers R01-R17, R100-R104 (see .admin-fix-tmp/plan.md).
steps: Read plan.md sections 0, 1 (A and E), 2, 3. Read admin_portal/signin.html, staff-login.js, js/portal.js, js/store.js, js/data.js (SEED), admin.js.

data.js: extend SEED() with NEW top-level keys only: staff [{id,name,type:'business'|'frontdesk'|'instructor',status:'active'|'inactive',last}] with ADM-001 Business Admin, ADM-101 Admin (HQ), INS-0042 Bob Tan Sensei plus 2-3 more; ledger (this-month + earlier payments, methods Stripe only, some failed/processing/outstanding); refunds; exceptions; guests (with trial/day/week passes, one with used trial); equipment; followups; closures; rosters ({}), memberInfo ({}), imports (failed/incomplete CSV rows), policies (registration 60, annual dues 48, package prices from PKG, discounts 65+=40% and 17-25/NSF=50%, booking rules 1 month ahead/1 day/4 hours/max 2 packages, auto-activation rules, approved payment methods ['Stripe'], templates, follow-up triggers 14 days/30 days), sentLog, interventions, cohorts. Keep existing keys untouched.

store.js (additive): ADMIN = parsed sessionStorage['ask-admin'] or null; isBA(); signInAdmin(acct) sets ask-role='admin' and ask-admin; signOut() also removes ask-admin; add an admSeed migration (like rmSeed) that pushes ~14 extra members (children, lapsed, expiring, outstanding, new within 90 days, External source) and ensures SESSIONS entries get mat/start/end defaults, without changing existing entries' current fields.

staff-login.js + signin.html: Instructor / Admin tabs, copy 'For instructors and office staff. Accounts are issued by a Business Admin.', demo IDs in hint (ADM-001 Business Admin, ADM-101 Admin), look up ID in DB.staff; unknown ID, inactive account ('deactivated') messages; read ?denied, ?expired, ?deactivated query flags; admin sign-in stores {id,name,type} via signInAdmin; remove all 'HQ Admin' / 'HQ office' role wording.

portal.js (additive, admin branch only): replace fixed PORTALS.admin.pages with an ADMIN_PAGES table [key, icon, label, group, baOnly] and a function building pages/label/me per ADMIN.type; BA groups Front desk / Management / Control rendered as non-link labels in the rail (add small .rail nav .grp rule in css/portal.css reusing .rail-role styling); optional P.tabs array for the phone tab bar (FD: dashboard,sessions,members,payments; BA: dashboard,insights,sessions,members); PARENT map roster->sessions, member->members, register->applications used when resolving cur; guard: no ADMIN -> signin?expired, BA-only page as FD -> index.html?baonly; per-role admin branch in openNotifs() computed from DB; page keys for new pages (equipment, followups, insights, revenue, grading, reports, policies, staff, imports). Do not change student/instructor branches except the optional D10 student bell tweak (r.extend === false shows 'Lesson returned').

Create admin_portal/admin-shell.js: header comment that role checks must be repeated server-side; stripBA() removing [data-ba] for FD before page scripts run; showFlash() for ?baonly toast; classState(date, cls, now) (Upcoming / Check-in open from 30 min before / Attendance pending / Done, 1 hour class); whyNotFor(person, cls) parameterised copy of data.js whyNot; discountFor(dob, nsVerified); small helpers for roster key, member lookup, ledger sums. Do not edit data.js whyNot.

Wording sweep in existing admin pages: replace 'HQ Admin' / 'waiting for HQ' / 'HQ closed' placeholder wording per R01; add admin-shell.js script tag after portal.js on every existing admin page. Replace hard-coded 1,248 / S$42,600 / payments array / '5 students' / data-count literals with values computed from data (R15) on index.html, members.html, payments.html, notify.html (renderers can be minimal here; FEAT-002..004 finish those pages).

Create verification harness in c:/Users/CedrikHwang/FSDP-C19/.admin-fix-tmp/verify/: serve.mjs (free port via listen(0), writes port.txt, MIME types), lib.mjs (npm i playwright-core into %TEMP%\admin-verify first; launch Edge via executablePath; abort non-127.0.0.1 requests; signInAs(page, 'ba'|'fd'|'instructor'|'student'); shot(); check(id, cond, msg) writes results.json), verify-feat1.mjs asserting R01-R14 and R100-R103 (sign-in per role through the UI, nav lists, tab bar at 390px, group labels, BA-only redirect + toast, deactivated message, DOM has no [data-ba] for FD, no 'HQ Admin' text, old-DB migration does not throw), verify-all.mjs running every verify-feat*.mjs, regress.mjs (instructor INS-0042 and all student pages load without console errors).

Run the harness; screenshot Admin and Business Admin index.html at 1280 and 390 into .admin-fix-tmp/screens/. Fix failures. Record in findings: new SEED keys and DB shapes, helper names exported by admin-shell.js, the verify lib API.
acceptance_criteria: Signing in through signin.html with ADM-101 shows an 'Admin' sidebar with exactly Today, Classes, Members, Payments, Registrations, Equipment, Follow-ups, Notifications; ADM-001 shows 'Business Admin' with those plus Insights, Revenue, Grading, Reports, Policies, Staff, Import issues under group labels.

As Admin (FD), opening admin_portal/policies.html (or any BA-only page) lands on index.html with the toast 'That page is for Business Admins'; with no session it lands on signin.html with the session-expired message.
Text 'HQ Admin' no longer appears on any admin page or signin.html.
Existing instructor and student portal pages load with no console errors; saved old localStorage DB (without new keys) loads without throwing.
node .admin-fix-tmp/verify/verify-feat1.mjs exits 0 and results.json has no failing FEAT-001 checks.
verification: git status --short (read only) shows only src/public edits plus .admin-fix-tmp and prompts untracked, nothing staged
findings: VERIFIED: verify-feat1 125/125 pass, regress 17/17 pass, results.json has 0 failures. Nothing staged or committed. SEED KEYS (data.js, new top-level): staff[{id,name,type business|frontdesk|instructor,status active|inactive,last}] (ADM-001 Grace Lim BA, ADM-101 Daniel Ong FD, ADM-102 Farah Yusof FD inactive, INS-0042/0031/0057/0063); ledger[{id,no,name,item,amt,method:'Stripe',date,st Paid|Processing|Failed|Outstanding,by desk|online|auto,inv}] (18 rows, one dated today); refunds[{id,no,name,item,amt,reason,by,at,status pending|approved|declined}]; exceptions[{id,kind registration|extension|access|mistake|refund,who,text,by,at,status}]; guests[{id,name,mobile,email,pass trial|day|week,used,until}] (G-04 trial used); equipment[{id,no,name,item,size,paid,status Requested|Ready at HQ|Handed over,at,by}]; followups[{id,no,name,kind declining|renewal|newcomer,owner staffId,due,attempts[{at,method,outcome,note}]}]; closures[{id,scope 'HQ'|'class',from,to,note}]; rosters{} keyed 'YYYY-MM-DD|HH:MM'; memberInfo{}; imports[{id,file,row,issue,name,detail,status open|fixed|dismissed}]; policies{registration:60,annualDues:48,packages[{id,name,amt}],discounts{senior{age,pct},student{from,to,pct}},booking{aheadMonths,minDays,cancelHours,maxPackages},autoActivation[{id,text,on}],methods['Stripe'],templates[{id,name,text}],followTriggers{declineDays:14,renewalDays:30}}; sentLog[{at,by,aud,title}]; interventions[{id,name,slot,start,before,after,decision}]; cohorts[{label,joined,kept}]. MEMBERS: admSeed===1 migration (store.js) adds 15 members (25 total) with extra optional fields: joinedAt, source 'ASK'|'External', kind 'adult'|'child', dob 'YYYY-MM-DD', guardian, phone, email, seen (days since last seen), left (lessons left), exp (ISO expiry), due (outstanding S$), nsf. The original 10 members lack these, so use fallbacks. SESSIONS get mat/start/end/online defaults. STORE: ADMIN ({id,name,type}), isBA(), signInAdmin(acct); signIn() clears ask-admin for non-admin roles; signOut clears it. PORTAL.JS: ADMIN_PAGES [key,icon,label,group,baOnly], ADMIN_PARENT {roster,member,register}, adminPortal(); P.pages entries are [key,icon,label,countFn,group]; P.tabs; P.parent; ADM_BLOCKED guard (FD on BA page -> index.html?baonly); no session -> signin.html?expired; wrong role -> ?denied. Rail group label CSS .rail nav .grp in portal.css. Bell admin branch per role links to pages (equipment, followups, revenue, imports, grading do not all exist yet). D10 student bell tweak done (r.extend===false -> 'Lesson returned'). ADMIN-SHELL.JS globals: stripBA(root) (call again after rendering new HTML), showFlash(), ageOn(dob,on), isThisMonth(d), ledgerSum(test), memberByNo(no), rosterKey(date,cls), closureOn(date), classState(date,cls,now) -> Upcoming|Check-in open|Attendance pending|Done|Cancelled, whyNotFor({g,gender,age},cls), discountFor(dob,nsVerified)->{pct,label}. admin-shell.js is already included on all 8 existing admin pages; new pages must include it after portal.js. Existing pages edited: index.html (computed counts, Grading stat and Promotion row are data-ba; the 'Low attendance flags' button still links to members, change to followups in FEAT-003 R70), payments.html (Collected today / Outstanding / Processing from ledger, table from this month's ledger; FD still sees failed rows, FEAT-002 should refine), members.html (#memSub computed, Export CSV is data-ba; note the export click handler only exists in admin.js reports(), so it does nothing on the members page, a pre-existing gap), notify.html (counts computed; FD still sees All members/By grade radios, FEAT-004 R94), applications.html heading now 'Registrations', sessions.html heading still 'Sessions' (FEAT-002 renames). LIMITS: BA-only pages insights, revenue, policies, staff, imports do not exist yet, so the redirect was tested on grading and reports, and the other keys are checked through ADMIN_PAGES. Parent highlight (roster/member/register) is untested until those pages exist. Existing .stat span CSS (portal.css line ~917) makes nested count-up numbers small; pre-existing. BA rail is taller than 800px so it scrolls inside the rail. VERIFY LIB (.admin-fix-tmp/verify/lib.mjs): launch() -> {browser,base,close}; newPage(env,{mobile}) -> {ctx,page,errors}; signInAs(page,base,'ba'|'fd'|'instructor'|'student') via the UI; shot(page,name) waits 3s then writes .admin-fix-tmp/screens/<name>.png; setFeat('FEAT-00N'); check(id,cond,msg) merges into results.json by feat+id; finish() sets exit code; text(page). serve.mjs exports startServer(). New verify-featN.mjs files are picked up by verify-all.mjs. Tips: change the live DB from inside the page (e.g. MC_REQS.push(...); save()), because an unloading page saves over outside edits; plant old-shape DBs with page.addInitScript. Screens saved: fd/ba-dashboard-1280/390.
